shots.scenePrompt: Aerial drone flyover descending through neon holographic skyscrapers of Neo-Shinjuku during a heavy midnight downpour, reflection of pink and cyan billboards across glossy wet pavement, cinematic anamorphic lens flares.
Nova in a weathered matte-black cybernetic trenchcoat walks through a crowded ramen alleyway, steam rising into cold night air, handheld camera tracking from behind.
Close up profile of Nova turning to face camera, eyes reflecting glowing amber terminal lights, rain droplets running down cybernetic cheek plating, volumetric rim light.
